newsitem.title: USA: Fremont Corp Q3 shr falls.
newsitem.headline: Fremont Corp Q3 shr falls.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: Latest quarter results include a $256,000 charge from the amortization of deferred pre-operating costs incurred in prior periods relating to the start-up of the new production facility.
Without the charge results pro forma net income for the latest quarter would have been $360,000 or $0.06 a share.
Latest nine months results include a $768,000 charge from the amortization of deferred pre-operating costs incurred in prior periods relating to the start-up of the new production facility.
Without the charge nine months pro forma net income would have been $1,286,000 or $0.22 a share.
Results for the nine months of 1995 include the effect of a non-recurring recapitalization cost of $770,000.
